overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting notice for its Saturday, March 14 meeting on March 12, fewer than 48 hours before it. No further remedial action was ordered because the Board acknowledged the error and committed to noticing future Saturday meetings by the previous Wednesday.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board held a Saturday, March 14 meeting without posting notice at least 48 hours before it.
allegations.key_passage: Because Saturdays are not included in the 48 hours required to notice a meeting, this notice was not timely posted.
